# @arki/code-editor

> A CodeMirror 6 editor for React with 13 light and dark themes and a theme picker. It reads no global state; you pass the theme in.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/code-editor/editor`: `CodeEditor`; types `CodeEditorLanguage`, `CodeEditorProps`.
- `@arki/code-editor/themes`: `getTheme`, `themeMap`, `themes`; types `EditorThemeId`, `ThemeConfig`, `ThemeVariant`.
- `@arki/code-editor/theme-picker`: `ThemeGroup`, `ThemePicker`, `ThemeSwatch`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## By task

- [Show an editor](docs/agent-guide.md#show-an-editor)

## Rules that bite

- The editor does not store the theme. Pass `getTheme(id).extension` every time.
- `getTheme` returns `github-dark` for an unknown id.
- `toml` and `text` show without highlighting.
- Use a bundler. The components import TypeScript source from `@arki/ui` and `@arki/icons`.
